content:
A multi-quarter read of Shopify's Q2 2026 results. Four growth measures cooled underneath a headline that accelerated, with the series and the sourcing shown for each.

In this issue

  • Method \*. Read the series, not the print.
  • The Numbers. Q2 2026, reported August 5, 2026 (Shopify Q2 2026 results release; Shopify Q2 2026 earnings call).
  • Thread One, the Five Questions. The Q2 call graded against all five as follows.
  • Thread Two, the Four Numbers Cooling. Four measures decelerated this quarter, and none of them appeared in the results release or the prepared remarks.
  • Cooling Number One, B2B. Put six quarters of B2B growth next to each other.
  • Nobody Knows How Big Shopify B2B Is. Shopify has never disclosed B2B GMV in dollars.
  • Cooling Number Two, Europe. Europe was the international growth engine in the Q1 story, and I quoted it at +48% in Shopify For Everyone...
